words: the lockstep rim lies on a coordinate mirror
inseparable.quote: in a fully symmetric face the lockstep rim lies on a coordinate mirror, so "rim" and "mirror" cannot be separated there; and faces with diagonal mirrors and free rims (T_d) fall below the mirror-free ones (T) by an amount growing like √A, so a diagonal-mirror share of up to about a third of the −0.196 is not excluded.
inseparable.src: NB 2026-11-15, the symmetric collapse (the review's wording); CLAIMS S7

corrected.quote: **So the 2026-11-12 picture is corrected, not reversed: the cost is mainly that edge-sharing faces die together and cannot hold each other up, and "the chaos runs thin along mirror lines" is not the mechanism of most of it.** [the mechanism itself is conjectured: nobody looked at the faces]
corrected.src: NB 2026-11-15, the symmetric collapse; CLAIMS S7 (mechanism: conjecture)

words: evolves exactly as gump on the orbit graph
A coordinate mirror never preserves a face
proved.quote: a G-symmetric state evolves exactly as gump on the orbit graph, and for free actions the factor 1/|G| is exact. Inside a {111} face the only mirrors are the three diagonal ones and their translates. A coordinate mirror never preserves a face: it exchanges two hull faces and fixes the rim row they share.
proved.src: NB 2026-11-15, the symmetric collapse; CLAIMS S5 (grade A)
